messages:
anya: heads up — noticed a midtail surge on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate around the same time we flipped the routing weights for fallback pools. p50 steady, p95 up ~120ms, p99 jumped ~450ms. screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/abcd1234 :eyes:
kevin: can you paste the dashboard query or the series id? might be a sample-origin shift rather than real latency regression
anya: here is the console query we use for the metric (copied from the widget):
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM requests
WHERE endpoint = '/v1/generate' AND region = 'us-west'
GROUP BY minute
```
I think the routing policy change also changed the `route_weight` so requests started hitting the `fallback-quantized` pool which has a slightly different batching profile
sam: quick check — did sample source change? console shows origin=client for the p50 series but origin=mixed for p99 when I hover
anya: yep that's what I saw. p99 seems dominated by a small number of requests that got routed to a different pool after the rollout. almost all of them have `quota_bucket=burst`
kevin: interesting — so two issues colliding: routing fallback + quota fallthrough. that makes percentile provenance ambiguous in the UI. users see a p99 and assume it's the same population across percentiles
ui-design: +1 to surfacing provenance. current tooltip only shows counts. can we add an inline "Sample origin / routing pool" row and a link to the rollout event? would reduce toil when debugging
anya: suggestion: widget should show a stacked pctl breakdown where each color is a sample_origin (client, proxy, fallback) and a small legend with counts. also an annotation when a routing weight change is deployed.
sam: from infra side, we can tag telemetry with `route_pool` at ingest time for a short window to avoid join-heavy queries. that would let the dashboard filter by pool without expensive post-aggregation joins
kevin: another short-term fix: when sample counts drop below threshold, mark p99 as "low-confidence" and surface sample_origin distribution. prevents people chasing false positives
anya: Agreed. For this thread: can someone (kev?) open a console PR to add the sample_origin row + rollout annotation? I'll open a short infra ticket to emit `route_pool` tag for 1hr after any routing policy change.
kevin: I will. Creating PR and linked issue: https://redwood.internal/PR/7890, will add the sample_origin row and the confidence badge.
deploy-bot: Routing policy change "fallback-weight-v2" deployed by @infra-ops at 2024-05-11T14:12:03Z — rollout: 20% -> 100% over 10m.
anya: thanks. once infra tags are up we should re-run the p99 drill and validate regression is purely route-mix. if not, escalate to runtime team.
sam: +1 — also adding a console unit test to fail if pctl widget shows >30% origin-mix for p99 with >10% weight change in last 15m.
ui-design: I'll sketch a tooltip mock and drop in the UX channel by EOD.
kevin: tracking card: INFRA-4520 (emit route_pool tag), CONS-1029 (sample origin row + confidence badge). linking PR -> issues.
anya: awesome — thanks everyone. i'll follow up after the infra tag is live and we re-evaluate the metric. :thumbsup:
